title: LFM2-1.2B layers 11 to 12, medicine block (donor skill map)

evidence.claim: skipping layers 11 to 12 of LFM2-1.2B raises the loss on 'medicine' text more than on general text; measured inside the donor only, not a gain on a host
evidence.metric: summed layer score over the block, nats (skill loss increase minus general loss increase)
evidence.split: search half of the skill text (the half that chose the part)
evidence.control: general_text loss increase, subtracted layer by layer

evidence.claim: share of the positive layer score that falls inside the block (layers 11 to 12)
evidence.metric: block_mass, fraction of the model's positive layer score
evidence.split: search half of the skill text (the half that chose the part)

evidence.claim: the same share, recomputed on the other half of the skill text for the same layers
evidence.metric: check_mass, fraction of the positive layer score
evidence.split: held-out half of the skill text (checks the choice)

evidence.claim: the per-layer score map from one half of the text agrees with the map from the other half
evidence.metric: split_half_r, Pearson r over layers (whole map, same value for every block of the skill)

signature.method: skip-layer map: loss increase on skill text when a decoder layer is skipped, minus the same on general_text (nats); the block is the shortest window that holds 60% of the positive score on the search half
signature.scope: measured inside the donor only, not a gain on a host
